gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histopathological diagnosis of glioblastoma (= IDHwt, WHO grade IV astrocytoma of the central nervous system (Louis, Perry et al. 2021).

candidate_evidence.quote: Participants will receive neo-adjuvant administration of intravenous immunotherapy on day 1 + day 22: ipilimumab + nivolumab IV.

The goal of this phase I interventional study is to determine the safety and feasibility of the proposed investigational (neo-)adjuvant treatment regimen in patients with resectable reccurent glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of resectable glioblastoma recurrence and/or progression following prior standard of care treatment (surgery for resectable lesions, radiation therapy and temozolomide chemotherapy).

agents.agent_name_registered: Neo-adjuvant nivolumab and ipililumab IV + adjuvant nivolumab and ipililumab IV

role_evidence.quote: Postoperatively, administration of immunotherapy will be continued, on day 15 postoperatively and every 2 weeks thereafter patients will receive nivolumab IV as well as ipililumab + nivolumab intracavitary.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody (IV and intracavitary via Ommaya)

agents.agent_name_registered: Neo-adjuvant nivolumab and ipililumab IV + adjuvant nivolumab and ipililumab IV

role_evidence.quote: Immunotherapy (nivolumab + ipililumab) will be injected into the brain tissue, followed by insertion of an Ommaya reservoir

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-CTLA-4 monoclonal antibody (IV and intracavitary via Ommaya)

coder_notes: Registered spelling 'ipililumab' mapped to ipilimumab. Intracavitary/intracranial administration via Ommaya reservoir coded formulation_flag new_route; device_dependent left false because the Ommaya reservoir is a delivery route, not a device that activates the drug or opens the BBB (R4 could be read as requiring true). IDH-wildtype is a diagnostic criterion only.
